segments.text: Day 108 · E2E encryption: Signal protocol, design implications।
What: How end-to-end encryption changes system design — the server can no longer read message content, which breaks server-side search, moderation, and multi-device sync naively.
How to complete: Explain the Signal protocol's double-ratchet at a high level, and name one product feature (e.g.
server-side search) that E2E encryption forces you to redesign.
